guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: Freshkills的公園功能建立在掩埋場工程覆蓋與持續監測之上。學徒要把雨水、滲出水、氣體、沉陷和植被畫成分開但互相影響的路徑。
guides.conceptEn: Freshkills park functions above engineered landfill containment and monitoring. Learners separate, then reconnect, stormwater, leachate, gas, settlement and vegetation pathways.
procedure: 先點選「覆蓋層水量邊界」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把逕流R改成20 mm，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 30 mm。與基準 20 mm比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「坡面雨水逕流」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把C降成0.50，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 150 m³。與基準 225 m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「排水溝與滯洪退水」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Q降成10 m³/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 18 h。與基準 12 h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「掩埋氣收集支線」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把收集率改成0.80，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 200 Nm³/d。與基準 300 Nm³/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「不均勻沉陷巡測」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把差異沉陷改成0.20 m，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 1 %。與基準 0.5 %比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「滲出水輸送能源」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把效率降成0.60，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 19.62 kW。與基準 16.35 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「植根與覆蓋層相容」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效寬度減成8 m，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6400 m²。與基準 9600 m²比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「草地棲地追蹤」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把分布改成四類各0.25，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.75 index。與基準 0.7 index比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「氣水儀表漂移」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「長期控制設備備援」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把各列A改成0.90，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.99 fraction。與基準 0.9975 fraction比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
procedureEn: Select the cover-system water balance measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only runoffR to20 mm with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 30 mm. Compare with baseline 20 mm and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the slope stormwater runoff measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only C to0.50 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 150 m³. Compare with baseline 225 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the ditch and detention drawdown measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only Q to10 m³/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 18 h. Compare with baseline 12 h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the landfill-gas collection laterals measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only capture fraction to0.80 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 200 Nm³/d. Compare with baseline 300 Nm³/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the differential-settlement survey measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only differential settlement to0.20 m with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 1 %. Compare with baseline 0.5 % and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the leachate-conveyance energy measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only efficiency to0.60 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 19.62 kW. Compare with baseline 16.35 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the root/cover compatibility measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only effective width to8 m with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6400 m². Compare with baseline 9600 m² and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the grassland-habitat tracking measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only proportions to four equal0.25 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.75 index. Compare with baseline 0.7 index and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the gas/water instrument drift measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the long-term control redundancy measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only each train availability to0.90 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.99 fraction. Compare with baseline 0.9975 fraction and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
evidence: 比較氣象、水位與滲出水流量，檢查季節儲水變化。在離線場景為「覆蓋層水量邊界」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
畫屋頂、路面與綠地分區，分別加權C並核對雨量站。在離線場景為「坡面雨水逕流」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
以水位記錄核對退水曲線，巡查積水與污物後才恢復場地。在離線場景為「排水溝與滯洪退水」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
結合井場流量、表面巡測與覆層資料，不只看總管抽氣量。在離線場景為「掩埋氣收集支線」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
設置穩定外部基準點，重複測量並查局部裂縫與積水。在離線場景為「不均勻沉陷巡測」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
同步量測流量、進出口壓差與真實功率，勿把視在功率當耗電。在離線場景為「滲出水輸送能源」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
在地圖標斷點，搭配定點觀察確認指定物種是否實際使用。在離線場景為「植根與覆蓋層相容」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
固定樣區、季節與採樣時長，另記棲地連續性與外來種。在離線場景為「草地棲地追蹤」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「氣水儀表漂移」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
畫故障樹並標出共享設備，測試單列退出時的完整流程。在離線場景為「長期控制設備備援」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
evidenceEn: Compare weather, water levels and leachate flow and inspect seasonal storage. Build an offline evidence table for cover-system water balance; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Map roofs, pavement and vegetation, weight C separately and check rainfall data. Build an offline evidence table for slope stormwater runoff; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Check the drawdown curve against level data and inspect standing water and debris before reopening. Build an offline evidence table for ditch and detention drawdown; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Combine well-field flow, surface surveys and cover information rather than header flow alone. Build an offline evidence table for landfill-gas collection laterals; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Use a stable external datum, repeat surveys and inspect cracks and ponding. Build an offline evidence table for differential-settlement survey; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Synchronize flow, pressure difference and real-power measurements; do not confuse apparent and real power. Build an offline evidence table for leachate-conveyance energy; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Map breaks and use fixed observations to verify use by specified species. Build an offline evidence table for root/cover compatibility; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Fix plots, season and effort and separately record connectivity and invasive species. Build an offline evidence table for grassland-habitat tracking; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for gas/water instrument drift; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Draw a fault tree marking shared assets and replay the process with one train unavailable. Build an offline evidence table for long-term control redundancy; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
pitfalls: 沉陷破壞排水坡度會造成積水與局部滲漏。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
把mm直接乘m²而未除1000會造成千倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
出水口被落葉堵塞會延長不可用時間。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
過度抽氣引入空氣可能改變氣體品質與火災風險。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
基準點也沉陷會使全部測點看似不動。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
葉輪磨損或閥門節流會改變工作點，須查泵曲線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
廊道被道路切斷時，相同面積仍可能失去連通。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
採樣努力量增加會製造看似改善，須對照基線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
兩列共用一個關鍵閥門，該閥失效仍會同時停產。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
pitfallsEn: Settlement can reverse drainage slopes, causing ponding and local leakage. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Multiplying mm bym² without dividing by1000 gives a thousandfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Leaf-blocked outlets lengthen unavailable time. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Excess extraction can draw in air, changing gas quality and fire risk. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
A settling datum can make all monitored points appear stationary. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Impeller wear or throttling changes the operating point; inspect the pump curve. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
A road break can destroy connectivity despite unchanged area. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Greater sampling effort can mimic improvement; compare with the baseline. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
A shared critical valve can stop both trains together. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。

related.title: 哥本哈根阿邁厄巴克焚化發電廠
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.
